questions.question: What does Proverbs 22 say is to be chosen rather than great riches?
What famous instruction about children does Proverbs 22 give?
options: A child who is raised up in great plenty will never once know any want or sorrow
Leave a child entirely to his own choices and wisdom will surely come to him at last
Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it
Spare the child from every hardship and trouble and surely he will only love you all the more
questions.answer: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it
